timeCard.label: Card text
timeCard.hint: Enter adds a manual line break. The text also wraps automatically to fit the card.

transitions.crossfadeHint: One shot dissolves smoothly into the next.
transitions.fadeBlackHint: Fade out through black, then reveal the next shot.
transitions.wipeLeftHint: The next shot pushes in from the left.
transitions.slideLeftHint: Both shots travel together in a fast lateral camera move.
transitions.slideRightHint: A reverse lateral slide reveals the next shot.
transitions.irisHint: The next shot opens from the centre like a cinematic iris.
transitions.dissolveHint: A textured, organic hand-off between shots.
transitions.pixelHint: The image breaks into pixels while changing shots.
transitions.blurHint: A fast horizontal blur hides the cut between moving shots.
transitions.zoomHint: Push through the outgoing image and land inside the next shot.
transitions.laterClockHint: Inserts an original time card with a moving analogue clock.
transitions.laterMemeHint: Inserts an original tropical time-card inspired by the classic meme format.
transitions.laterCinemaHint: Inserts an elegant cinematic intertitle between the two clips.
